title: ジャパンCの後に・ライバルだから

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The fierce battle between Sakura Chiyono O and Maruzensky stirs the crowd into a broiling frenzy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And the racers themselves are just as impassioned by their battle. They realize how inspiring it is to have a rival, and how badly they don't want to lose.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the race, Maruzensky hesitantly asks Sakura Chiyono O if she would like to run together with her again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Without a hint of hesitation, Sakura Chiyono O enthusiastically says that of course she would, and that she'll win next time for sure.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Their promised race may be behind them, but these racers' eyes will surely continue shining with the desire to compete. After all, that's what it means to have a rival.
